newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Russia sign bilateral debt accord.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Russia sign bilateral debt accord.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Friday that a $2.3-billion debt rescheduling agreement was signed on Thursday between Russia and the United States.

Treasury said the agreement was signed by Russian Deputy Finance Minister of Finance Michael Kasyanov and Deputy U.S. Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers. It formally implements for the United States an accord reached last April between the Paris Club of official creditors and Russia.
It stretches out Russia's payment period for up to 25 years on certain principal and interest payments falling due from 1996-99 and on certain loans due after 199.
